about:
S&K Electronics, Inc. was founded in 1984 by the Confederated Salish and Kootenai Tribes on the Flathead Indian Reservation in Ronan, Montana. The tribally-owned company operates from a 42,000-square-foot facility spanning three buildings in the Mission Valley.

The contract manufacturer specializes in high-reliability circuit card assembly using surface-mount and through-hole technologies, custom wire harnesses, and electromechanical box builds. Its capabilities extend to automated optical inspection, flying probe and in-circuit testing, 2D/3D X-ray inspection, conformal coating, and an in-house precision machine shop. The facility supports high-mix, low-to-high volume turnkey production with a workforce of 51 to 200 employees.

S&K serves aerospace and defense prime contractors, medical equipment makers, industrial automation firms, telecommunications companies, and energy sector clients. The company is ITAR registered and holds AS9100D certification, making it a qualified supplier for mission-critical defense and aerospace programs.

The business was established to create economic opportunity for the tribal community while delivering quality-driven electronics manufacturing. S&K emphasizes financially stable operations, 100% inspection and testing, and adherence to IPC Class 3 workmanship standards as key differentiators.
